riskFactors: Revolutionary VFX & experimental technology (slit-scan, front projection)
Extensive animal work with seasonal dependency (dry season)
Complex stunt sequences with animal and mechanical elements
Extremely long makeup application times (6+ hours for aging)
Massive, complex set construction (rotating centrifuge, space station)
Weather dependency for all 'Dawn of Man' exterior sequences
Long production timeline increasing risk of unforeseen issues

Stunt sequences require certified safety coordinator and protocols.

executionSequence.description: Dispatch data packets to agents for parallel processing of hard/soft constraints and resource availability.
Upon receipt of Phase 1 outputs, consolidate data and dispatch to the Optimization agent to generate schedule proposals.

dataFlowValidation.validation_requirements: Cross-reference the final constraint set from the Compliance agent against the resource availability matrix from the Logistics agent to identify any immediate, unresolvable conflicts before optimization.

qualityChecks: Verify 100% union compliance for turnaround and meal breaks in all proposed schedules.
Check that all weather-dependent scenes are scheduled within the specified seasonal window (dry season).
Ensure schedules account for long makeup prep times by blocking appropriate character days.
Validate that location groupings minimize company moves as per optimization goals.
Confirm that all high-risk scenes (stunts, animals) have appropriate resource allocation.
